theme: retro Shanghai travel scrapbook portrait poster
visual_concept: A nostalgic handmade scrapbook poster celebrating Shanghai, centered on a soft portrait of a young woman wearing white headphones, surrounded by torn paper notes, taped photo cutouts, stamps, doodles and large hand-lettered typography. The image should feel like a personal travel journal page, aged, tactile and romantic.

style.overall: vintage scrapbook collage, retro travel journal, handmade paper craft aesthetic
style.medium: photorealistic portrait blended with torn-paper collage, hand lettering, stickers and printed ephemera
style.mood: nostalgic, romantic, dreamy, warm, youthful, personal

main_subject.description: young East Asian woman with long dark hair, soft natural makeup, wearing large white over-ear headphones and an ivory knit sweater
main_subject.pose: turning back over her shoulder, looking calmly toward the viewer
main_subject.framing: oval portrait cutout in the center, like a pasted magazine photo with torn cream border
main_subject.lighting: soft outdoor sunlight with warm highlights and gentle bokeh background

composition.layout: vertical poster with a central oval portrait, large decorative headline at the top and oversized script word at the bottom
composition.background: dark olive-green aged paper board with distressed cream torn border around the entire poster
composition.top_typography: large cream-and-green hand-painted script phrase across the top
composition.bottom_typography: oversized sweeping script word 'Shanghai' across the lower third, with thick cream outline and dark green fill
collage_elements: torn note paper pinned on the left
handwritten note paper taped on the right
two eye close-up photo cutouts near the lower sides
small postage-stamp landscape in the lower-right area
guardian lion / stone lion illustration sticker
composition.visual_flow: viewer reads the top phrase, moves to the central portrait, then lands on the large 'Shanghai' lettering

visible_text.text: with the beautiful girl that i met
visible_text.placement: top area, large hand-painted cursive lettering
visible_text.style: dark green brush script with thick cream paper-like outline

visible_text.placement: bottom third, very large decorative script
visible_text.style: bold dark green retro script with thick cream outline and shadow

visible_text.text: The beauty of her face was beyond of my wildest dream

typography.primary_style: large expressive brush-script lettering, handmade and slightly imperfect
typography.secondary_style: casual handwritten notes in dark green ink
requirements: text should look hand-drawn and integrated into paper collage
small handwriting may feel organic but should remain plausible

materials_and_details.paper: layered torn cream paper, aged notebook scraps, rough fibrous edges
materials_and_details.tape: semi-transparent green washi tape and dotted tape holding photos and notes
materials_and_details.pins: round olive-green metal push pins casting tiny shadows
materials_and_details.photos: slightly faded printed photos with film grain, dust and worn edges
materials_and_details.doodles: simple black ink travel doodles and small decorative stars

camera_and_rendering.poster_view: flat-lay scanned scrapbook page, straight-on view
camera_and_rendering.depth: subtle layered shadows between paper pieces
camera_and_rendering.finish: high-resolution tactile print collage, analog scrapbook texture

quality_requirements: strong vintage Shanghai travel scrapbook feeling
central portrait must be soft and attractive
torn paper layers must feel physical and handmade
large decorative typography must be legible
green and cream palette should remain cohesive
